headline: US Hybrid Vehicle Sales Rise While Electric Vehicle Growth Slows
summary: Hybrid electric vehicles gained market share in the U.S. in the third quarter of 2026, while battery electric vehicle growth slowed following tax credit expirations.
why: The U.S. Energy Information Administration provides official energy statistics and market analysis for the United States.

impacts.name: Automotive
impacts.why: Expiration of tax credits and shifting consumer preferences slow pure electric vehicle adoption while benefiting hybrids.
